name: Geometric morph chain
visual_intent: One shape becomes the next (circle, triangle, square, star) in a sequence, so an idea transforms without a cut.

parameters.name: shapes
parameters.description: Paths from Studio.draw.shape with the same points count

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: One morph per beat or per narrated term

fallbacks: Crossfade between shapes, or blob-morph for organic shapes.

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/studio-runtime/reference-techniques.html (mid-morph and exact end state) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
